text:
sara_support: hey team, customer on Dedicated tier (acct: ACCT-231) reports repeated failures when calling our payments tool via tool/invoke. error is a 400 from our gateway: "schema validation failed: additionalProperties [\"billing_profile\"] not allowed; required property 'session_id' missing". they pasted the payload they sent.

sara_support: payload they sent: ```json
{
  "user_id": 4321,
  "billing_profile": {
    "id": "cust-123",
    "amount": 29.99,
    "currency": "USD"
  },
  "items": []
}
```

sara_support: customer says it used to work last week; they started seeing failures after a platform patch rolled yesterday. high priority, invoicing pipeline blocked.

leo_eng: looking. can you confirm which model/runtime path this hit? gateway -> router -> payments-tool (fn) ? any request id?

sara_support: request id: r-20240325-9a7b. route: hosted-gateway -> payments-service -> fn-invoke. customer submitted curl repro, attaching below.

sara_support: repro curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tool/invoke \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"tool":"payments.process","args":{"user_id":4321,"billing_profile":{"id":"cust-123","amount":29.99,"currency":"USD"},"items":[]}}'
```

tim_sre: quick note — deploy logs show a schema tighten merged 2024-03-24 at 03:12 UTC that enabled "additionalProperties": false on the payments tool function schema. rollback window closed but canary is still available.

maria_oncall: possible culprit: we had a field rename recently from "session_id" -> "session" and we added stricter types for amounts (string->number coercion removed). customer payload shows no session_id. also billing_profile used to be accepted in metadata but now blocked as additionalProperties.

leo_eng: i replicated locally by running the same curl with a short-lived token and got identical validation error. stack trace from fn-invoke logs: ```
ValidationError: instance is not of a type(s) "object" at /args: additionalProperties "billing_profile" is not allowed
 at validate (/srv/validator/index.js:87:15)
 at handleInvoke (/srv/tool-invoke/handler.js:142:9)
```

leo_eng: root cause: the schema change removed a permissive wrapper that used to accept top-level billing metadata under args.meta. now payments.process expects args to follow the strict schema with required session_id (string) and items array items.amount as integer cents. also our gateway wasn't coercing floats to cents.

sara_support: customer notes their client lib sends amount as float dollars (29.99) and relies on our gateway to accept that. their integration can't change immediately.

tim_sre: options: 1) emergency compatibility hotfix — reintroduce lenient schema/accept billing_profile as meta passthrough in the router; 2) patch client guidance + migrations (longer). we can flip a canary to allow additionalProperties on payments-tool to restore blocked keys.

maria_oncall: suggest canary rollback to pre-03-24 validator for payments-service for 10% traffic, monitor errors. i can run the canary.

deploy_bot: canary rollback started for service/payments-service @ 1719456940, target 10% traffic. diff: revert schema change commit 5f2a3c.

leo_eng: i pushed a small compatibility shim to the router to coerce numeric dollar amounts into integer cents and map billing_profile into args.meta when present. patch id: PR#4287. requesting fast-track review.

leo_eng: temp schema note: we'll accept numbers or strings for items[].amount and coerce floats by multiply 100 and round. also re-allow unknown props under args but log them for audit.

sara_support: i informed the customer of temporary canary and shim. they're grateful. escalated billing team for follow-up on a more robust integration guide.

tim_sre: monitoring: error rate on payments-tool dropped from 73% -> 7% on canary route. keeping watch for auth failures (token edgecases) and potential billing mismatches.

maria_oncall: next steps: 1) extend compatibility shim to Dedicated and Private builds, 2) schedule schema migration doc and deprecation notice, 3) follow up with customer with repro-proof steps. assigning to leo_eng for the shim rollout.

leo_eng: ack. will open follow-up ticket with checklist + rollout timeline. we'll include unit tests for amount coercion and additionalProperties logging.

sara_support: thanks all. i'll keep thread updated with customer responses and confirm when they've resumed invoicing. :thumbsup:
